title: BIFROST SDK Dump Output
description: Engine-agnostic schema for the offsets.json artifact produced by every dumper (Unreal, Unity Mono, Unity IL2CPP, Source, Blizzard, AdobeAIR). Validates that the output is structurally well-formed regardless of whether a real game process was attached.

engine.description: Engine identifier. Examples: unreal5, unity_mono, unity_il2cpp, source, blizzard. Not enum-constrained so new engines don't break the schema.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 or human timestamp when the dump was generated.

verified_against_live_process.description: False when produced from synthetic fixtures or other non-live sources. Frontend should warn when false. Optional today; will become required when Tier 2 fixtures land.

bridge_version.description: Optional bridge build SHA / timestamp for debugging stale-backend issues.

offsets.description: Map of class full-name -> class record. Class names are free-form strings; each value must conform to the class record schema below.

size.description: Total class size. Hex string like '0x1A0' (the canonical format), or an integer for engines that emit raw numbers.

super.description: Parent class name. Empty string is allowed (root classes).

fields.description: Map of field name -> field record.

offset.description: Field offset within its parent. Hex string '0x18' is canonical. Null is allowed for engines like AdobeAIR/AS3 where offsets are runtime-determined.

size.description: Field size in bytes. Integer for native engines, null for AS3-style runtime layouts.

type.description: Engine-native type name (e.g. 'IntProperty' in Unreal, 'System.Int32' in Unity Mono, 'Number' in AS3).
